claims.text: Because the base 3 is bigger than 2, 3^40 might seem larger at first glance.
The larger exponent on 2 (64 vs 40) means the base alone doesn't settle the comparison.
40·log₂3 is about 63.40, which is less than 64.
3^40 is approximately 2^63.4, which is less than 2^64.
3^40 falls short of 2^64 by about a third.
The base-size intuition is outweighed by the exponent gap.
